While displayed, your Constitution and Dexterity dice are d12, and you may play only boons that have the Goblin, Melee, Poison, or Vermin (☐ or Divine) trait; add the Vermin trait to your checks. At the end of any encounter, you may recharge all cards displayed by this power.

roles.name: Verminator
powers: When you encounter a card, you may display a boon that has the Divine trait (☐ and you may recharge a card displayed by this power to evade your encounter). While displayed, your Constitution and Dexterity dice are d12, and you may play only boons that have the Goblin, Melee, Poison, or Vermin (☐ or Divine) trait; add the Vermin trait to your checks. (☐ You may recharge a card displayed by this power to add 1d4 to your check.) At the end of any encounter, you may recharge all cards displayed by this power. (☐ When you defeat and would banish a card that has the Goblin, Swarm, or Vermin trait, you may display it as if it were a boon that has the Divine trait.)

When you attempt (☐ or a character at your location attempts) a check that invokes the Poison, Swarm, or Vermin trait, add 1d6 (☐ and before the roll, you may draw a card) (☐ or recharge a random card from your discard pile).
☐ You may recharge a card to add the Vermin trait to your check (☐ or a check by a character at your location).
☐ Allies you play and allies in your hand gain the Vermin trait.

roles.name: Beetle Borker
powers: When you encounter a card, you may display a boon that has the Divine trait (☐ and you may recharge a card displayed by this power to evade your encounter). (☐ After any of your checks, you may draw any of these cards.) At the end of any encounter, you may recharge all cards displayed by this power.
When you attempt a check that invokes the Poison, Swarm, or Vermin trait, add 1d6 (☐ and before the roll, you may draw a card). (☐ If you do, add an additional 1d6.)
☐ You may recharge a card to reduce Poison (☐ or Acid or Cold) damage dealt to you (☐ or to a character at your location) to 0 (☐ then you may draw a card).
☐ You may ignore a bane's immunity to the Poison trait.
